33 module lsu import cvw::*;  #(parameter cvw_t P) (
34   input  logic                    clk, reset,
35   input  logic                    StallM, FlushM, StallW, FlushW,
36   output logic                    LSUStallM,                            // LSU stalls pipeline during a multicycle operation
37   // connected to cpu (controls)
38   input  logic [1:0]              MemRWE,                               // Read/Write control
39   input  logic [1:0]              MemRWM,                               // Read/Write control
40   input  logic [2:0]              Funct3M,                              // Size of memory operation
41   input  logic [6:0]              Funct7M,                              // Atomic memory operation function
42   input  logic [1:0]              AtomicM,                              // Atomic memory operation
43   input  logic                    FlushDCacheM,                         // Flush D cache to next level of memory
44   input  logic [3:0]              CMOpM,                                // 1: cbo.inval; 2: cbo.flush; 4: cbo.clean; 8: cbo.zero
45   input  logic                    LSUPrefetchM,                         // Prefetch; presently unused
46   output logic                    CommittedM,                           // Delay interrupts while memory operation in flight
47   output logic                    SquashSCW,                            // Store conditional failed disable write to GPR
48   output logic                    DCacheMiss,                           // D cache miss for performance counters
49   output logic                    DCacheAccess,                         // D cache memory access for performance counters
50   // address and write data
51   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       IEUAdrE,                              // Execution stage memory address
52   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       IEUAdrM,                              // Memory stage memory address
53   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       WriteDataM,                           // Write data from IEU
54   output logic [P.LLEN-1:0]       ReadDataW,                            // Read data to IEU or FPU
55   // cpu privilege
56   input  logic [1:0]              PrivilegeModeW,                       // Current privilege mode
57   input  logic                    BigEndianM,                           // Swap byte order to big endian
58   input  logic                    sfencevmaM,                           // Virtual memory address fence, invalidate TLB entries
59   output logic                    DCacheStallM,                         // D$ busy with multicycle operation
60   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       IEUAdrxTvalM,                         // IEUAdrM, but could be spilled onto the next cacheline or virtual page.
61   // fpu
62   input  logic [P.FLEN-1:0]       FWriteDataM,                          // Write data from FPU
63   input  logic                    FpLoadStoreM,                         // Selects FPU as store for write data
64   // faults
65   output logic                    LoadPageFaultM, StoreAmoPageFaultM,   // Page fault exceptions
66   output logic                    LoadMisalignedFaultM,                 // Load address misaligned fault
67   output logic                    LoadAccessFaultM,                     // Load access fault (PMA)
68   output logic                    HPTWInstrAccessFaultF,                // HPTW generated access fault during instruction fetch
69   output logic                    HPTWInstrPageFaultF,                  // HPTW generated access fault during instruction fetch
70   // cpu hazard unit (trap)
71   output logic                    StoreAmoMisalignedFaultM,             // Store or AMO address misaligned fault
72   output logic                    StoreAmoAccessFaultM,                 // Store or AMO access fault
73   // connect to ahb
74   output logic [P.PA_BITS-1:0]    LSUHADDR,                             // Bus address from LSU to EBU
75   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       HRDATA,                               // Bus read data from LSU to EBU
76   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       LSUHWDATA,                            // Bus write data from LSU to EBU
77   input  logic                    LSUHREADY,                            // Bus ready from LSU to EBU
78   output logic                    LSUHWRITE,                            // Bus write operation from LSU to EBU
79   output logic [2:0]              LSUHSIZE,                             // Bus operation size from LSU to EBU
80   output logic [2:0]              LSUHBURST,                            // Bus burst from LSU to EBU
81   output logic [1:0]              LSUHTRANS,                            // Bus transaction type from LSU to EBU
82   output logic [P.XLEN/8-1:0]     LSUHWSTRB,                            // Bus byte write enables from LSU to EBU
83   // page table walker
84   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       SATP_REGW,                            // SATP (supervisor address translation and protection) CSR
85   input  logic                    STATUS_MXR, STATUS_SUM, STATUS_MPRV,  // STATUS CSR bits: make executable readable, supervisor user memory, machine privilege
86   input  logic [1:0]              STATUS_MPP,                           // Machine previous privilege mode
87   input  logic                    ENVCFG_PBMTE,                         // Page-based memory types enabled
88   input  logic                    ENVCFG_ADUE,                          // HPTW A/D Update enable
89   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       PCSpillF,                             // Fetch PC
90   input  logic                    ITLBMissOrUpdateAF,                   // ITLB miss causes HPTW (hardware pagetable walker) walk or update access bit
91   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       PTE,                                  // Page table entry write to ITLB
92   output logic [1:0]              PageType,                             // Type of page table entry to write to ITLB
93   output logic                    ITLBWriteF,                           // Write PTE to ITLB
94   output logic                    SelHPTW,                              // During a HPTW walk the effective privilege mode becomes S_MODE
95   input var logic [7:0]           PMPCFG_ARRAY_REGW[P.PMP_ENTRIES-1:0], // PMP configuration from privileged unit
96   input var logic [P.PA_BITS-3:0] PMPADDR_ARRAY_REGW[P.PMP_ENTRIES-1:0] // PMP address from privileged unit
97 );
98   localparam logic MISALIGN_SUPPORT = P.ZICCLSM_SUPPORTED & P.DCACHE_SUPPORTED;
99   localparam MLEN = MISALIGN_SUPPORT ? 2*P.LLEN : P.LLEN; // widen buffer for misaligned accessess
100 
101   logic [P.XLEN+1:0]     IEUAdrExtM;                             // Memory stage address zero-extended to PA_BITS or XLEN whichever is longer
102   logic [P.XLEN+1:0]     IEUAdrExtE;                             // Execution stage address zero-extended to PA_BITS or XLEN whichever is longer
103   logic [P.PA_BITS-1:0]  PAdrM;                                  // Physical memory address
104   logic [P.XLEN+1:0]     IHAdrM;                                 // Either IEU or HPTW memory address
105 
106   logic [1:0]            PreLSURWM;                              // IEU or HPTW Read/Write signal
107   logic [1:0]            LSURWM;                                 // IEU or HPTW Read/Write signal gated by LR/SC
108   logic [2:0]            LSUFunct3M;                             // IEU or HPTW memory operation size
109   logic [6:0]            LSUFunct7M;                             // AMO function gated by HPTW
110   logic [1:0]            LSUAtomicM;                             // AMO signal gated by HPTW
111   logic [3:0]            LSUCMOpM;                               // CMOpM gated by HPTW
112 
113   logic                  GatedStallW;                            // Hazard unit StallW gated when SelHPTW = 1
114 
115   logic                  LSUBusStallM;                           // Bus interface busy with multicycle operation masked by HPTWFlushW
116   logic                  HPTWStall;                              // HPTW busy with multicycle operation
117   logic                  DCacheBusStallM;                        // Cache or bus stall
118   logic                  CacheBusHPWTStall;                      // Cache, bus, or hptw is requesting a stall
119   logic                  SelSpillE;                              // Align logic detected a spill and needs to stall
120 
121   logic                  CacheableM;                             // PMA indicates memory address is cacheable
122   logic                  BusCommittedM;                          // Bus memory operation in flight, delay interrupts
123   logic                  DCacheCommittedM;                       // D$ memory operation started, delay interrupts
124 
125   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     DTIMReadDataWordM;                      // DTIM read data
126   logic [MLEN-1:0]       DCacheReadDataWordM;                    // D$ read data
127   logic [MLEN-1:0]       LSUWriteDataSpillM;                     // Final write data
128   logic [MLEN/8-1:0]     ByteMaskSpillM;                         // Selects which bytes within a word to write
129   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     DCacheReadDataWordSpillM;               // D$ read data
130   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     ReadDataWordMuxM;                       // DTIM or D$ read data
131   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     LittleEndianReadDataWordM;              // Endian-swapped read data
132   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     ReadDataM;                              // Final read data
133 
134   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]     IHWriteDataM;                           // IEU or HPTW write data
135   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]     IMAWriteDataM;                          // IEU, HPTW, or AMO write data
136   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     IMAFWriteDataM;                         // IEU, HPTW, AMO, or FPU write data
137   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     LittleEndianWriteDataM;                 // Ending-swapped write data
138   logic [P.LLEN-1:0]     LSUWriteDataM;                          // Final write data
139   logic [(P.LLEN-1)/8:0] ByteMaskM;                              // Selects which bytes within a word to write
140   logic [(P.LLEN-1)/8:0] ByteMaskExtendedM;                      // Selects which bytes within a word to write
141   logic [1:0]            MemRWSpillM;
142   logic                  SpillStallM;
143 
144   logic                  DTLBMissM;                              // DTLB miss causes HPTW walk
145   logic                  DTLBWriteM;                             // Writes PTE and PageType to DTLB
146   logic                  LSULoadAccessFaultM;                    // Load access fault
147   logic                  LSUStoreAmoAccessFaultM;                // Store access fault
148   logic                  HPTWFlushW;                             // HPTW needs to flush operation
149   logic                  LSUFlushW;                              // HPTW or hazard unit flushes operation
150   logic                  SelDTIM;                                // Select DTIM rather than bus or D$
151   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]     WriteDataZM;
152   logic                  LSULoadPageFaultM, LSUStoreAmoPageFaultM;
153   logic                  DTLBMissOrUpdateDAM;
154 
155   /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
156   // Pipeline for IEUAdr E to M
157   // Zero-extend address to 34 bits for XLEN=32
158   /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
159 
160   flopenrc #(P.XLEN) AddressMReg(clk, reset, FlushM, ~StallM, IEUAdrE, IEUAdrM);
161   if(MISALIGN_SUPPORT) begin : ziccslm_align
162     logic [P.XLEN-1:0] IEUAdrSpillE;
163     logic [P.XLEN-1:0] IEUAdrSpillM;
164     align #(P) align(.clk, .reset, .StallM, .FlushM, .IEUAdrE, .IEUAdrM, .Funct3M, .FpLoadStoreM,
165                      .MemRWM,
166                      .DCacheReadDataWordM, .CacheBusHPWTStall, .SelHPTW,
167                      .ByteMaskM, .ByteMaskExtendedM, .LSUWriteDataM, .ByteMaskSpillM, .LSUWriteDataSpillM,
168                      .IEUAdrSpillE, .IEUAdrSpillM, .IEUAdrxTvalM, .SelSpillE, .DCacheReadDataWordSpillM, .SpillStallM);
169     assign IEUAdrExtM = {2'b00, IEUAdrSpillM};
170     assign IEUAdrExtE = {2'b00, IEUAdrSpillE};
171   end else begin : no_ziccslm_align
172     assign IEUAdrExtM = {2'b00, IEUAdrM};
173     assign IEUAdrExtE = {2'b00, IEUAdrE};
174     assign SelSpillE = 1'b0;
175     assign DCacheReadDataWordSpillM = DCacheReadDataWordM;
176     assign ByteMaskSpillM = ByteMaskM;
177     assign LSUWriteDataSpillM = LSUWriteDataM;
178     assign MemRWSpillM = MemRWM;
179     assign {SpillStallM} = 1'b0;
180     assign IEUAdrxTvalM = IEUAdrM;
181   end
182 
183     if(P.ZICBOZ_SUPPORTED) begin : cboz
184       assign WriteDataZM = LSUCMOpM[3] ? 0 : WriteDataM;
185    end else begin : cboz
186       assign WriteDataZM = WriteDataM;
187     end
188 
189   /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
190   // HPTW (only needed if VM supported)
191   // MMU include PMP and is needed if any privileged supported
192   /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
193 
194   if(P.VIRTMEM_SUPPORTED) begin : hptw
195     hptw #(P) hptw(.clk, .reset, .MemRWM, .AtomicM, .ITLBMissOrUpdateAF, .ITLBWriteF,
196       .DTLBMissOrUpdateDAM, .DTLBWriteM,
197       .FlushW, .DCacheBusStallM, .SATP_REGW, .PCSpillF,
198       .STATUS_MXR, .STATUS_SUM, .STATUS_MPRV, .STATUS_MPP, .ENVCFG_ADUE, .PrivilegeModeW,
199       .ReadDataM(ReadDataM[P.XLEN-1:0]), // ReadDataM is LLEN, but HPTW only needs XLEN
200       .WriteDataM(WriteDataZM), .Funct3M, .LSUFunct3M, .Funct7M, .LSUFunct7M,
201       .IEUAdrExtM, .PTE, .IHWriteDataM, .PageType, .PreLSURWM, .LSUAtomicM,
202       .IHAdrM, .CMOpM, .LSUCMOpM, .HPTWStall, .SelHPTW,
203       .HPTWFlushW, .LSULoadAccessFaultM, .LSUStoreAmoAccessFaultM,
204       .LoadAccessFaultM, .StoreAmoAccessFaultM, .HPTWInstrAccessFaultF,
205       .LoadPageFaultM, .StoreAmoPageFaultM, .LSULoadPageFaultM, .LSUStoreAmoPageFaultM, .HPTWInstrPageFaultF
206 );
207   end else begin // No HPTW, so signals are not multiplexed
208     assign PreLSURWM = MemRWM;
209     assign IHAdrM = IEUAdrExtM;
210     assign LSUFunct3M = Funct3M;
211     assign LSUFunct7M = Funct7M;
212     assign LSUAtomicM = AtomicM;
213     assign LSUCMOpM = CMOpM;
214     assign IHWriteDataM = WriteDataZM;
215     assign LoadAccessFaultM = LSULoadAccessFaultM;
216     assign StoreAmoAccessFaultM = LSUStoreAmoAccessFaultM;
217     assign LoadPageFaultM = LSULoadPageFaultM;
218     assign StoreAmoPageFaultM = LSUStoreAmoPageFaultM;
219     assign {HPTWStall, SelHPTW, PTE, PageType, DTLBWriteM, ITLBWriteF, HPTWFlushW} = '0;
220     assign {HPTWInstrAccessFaultF, HPTWInstrPageFaultF} = '0;
221    end
222 
223   // CommittedM indicates the cache, bus, or HPTW are busy with a multiple cycle operation.
224   // CommittedM is 1 after the first cycle and until the last cycle.  Partially completed memory
225   // operations delay interrupts until the next instruction by suppressing pending interrupts in
226   // the trap module.
227   assign CommittedM = SelHPTW | DCacheCommittedM | BusCommittedM;
228   assign GatedStallW = StallW & ~SelHPTW;
229   assign DCacheBusStallM = DCacheStallM | LSUBusStallM;
230   assign CacheBusHPWTStall = DCacheBusStallM | HPTWStall;
231   assign LSUStallM = CacheBusHPWTStall | SpillStallM;
232 
233   /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
234   // MMU and misalignment fault logic required if privileged unit exists
235   /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
236   if(P.ZICSR_SUPPORTED == 1) begin : dmmu
237     logic DisableTranslation;                             // During HPTW walk or D$ flush disable virtual memory address translation
238     logic WriteAccessM;
239     logic DataUpdateDAM;                                  // DTLB hit needs to update dirty or access bits
240 
241     assign DisableTranslation = SelHPTW | FlushDCacheM;
242     assign WriteAccessM = PreLSURWM[0];
243     mmu #(.P(P), .TLB_ENTRIES(P.DTLB_ENTRIES), .IMMU(0))
244     dmmu(.clk, .reset, .SATP_REGW, .STATUS_MXR, .STATUS_SUM, .STATUS_MPRV, .STATUS_MPP, .ENVCFG_PBMTE, .ENVCFG_ADUE,
245       .PrivilegeModeW, .DisableTranslation, .VAdr(IHAdrM), .Size(LSUFunct3M[1:0]),
246       .PTE, .PageTypeWriteVal(PageType), .TLBWrite(DTLBWriteM), .TLBFlush(sfencevmaM),
247       .PhysicalAddress(PAdrM), .TLBMiss(DTLBMissM), .Cacheable(CacheableM), .Idempotent(), .SelTIM(SelDTIM),
248       .InstrAccessFaultF(), .LoadAccessFaultM(LSULoadAccessFaultM),
249       .StoreAmoAccessFaultM(LSUStoreAmoAccessFaultM), .InstrPageFaultF(), .LoadPageFaultM(LSULoadPageFaultM),
250       .StoreAmoPageFaultM(LSUStoreAmoPageFaultM),
251       .LoadMisalignedFaultM, .StoreAmoMisalignedFaultM,
252       .UpdateDA(DataUpdateDAM), .CMOpM(LSUCMOpM),
253       .AtomicAccessM(|LSUAtomicM), .ExecuteAccessF(1'b0),
254       .WriteAccessM, .ReadAccessM(PreLSURWM[1]),
255       .PMPCFG_ARRAY_REGW, .PMPADDR_ARRAY_REGW);
256 
257     assign DTLBMissOrUpdateDAM = DTLBMissM | (P.SVADU_SUPPORTED & DataUpdateDAM);
258   end else begin  // No MMU, so no PMA/page faults and no address translation
259     assign DTLBMissOrUpdateDAM = '0;
260     assign {DTLBMissM, LSULoadAccessFaultM, LSUStoreAmoAccessFaultM, LoadMisalignedFaultM, StoreAmoMisalignedFaultM} = '0;
261     assign {LSULoadPageFaultM, LSUStoreAmoPageFaultM} = '0;
262     assign PAdrM = IHAdrM[P.PA_BITS-1:0];
263     assign CacheableM = 1'b1;
264     assign SelDTIM = P.DTIM_SUPPORTED & ~P.BUS_SUPPORTED; // if no PMA then select dtim if there is a DTIM.  If there is
265     // a bus then this is always 0. Cannot have both without PMA.
266   end

30 module mmu import cvw::*;  #(parameter cvw_t P,
31                              parameter TLB_ENTRIES = 8, IMMU = 0) (
32   input  logic                 clk, reset,
33   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]    SATP_REGW,          // Current value of satp CSR (from privileged unit)
34   input  logic                 STATUS_MXR,         // Status CSR: make executable page readable
35   input  logic                 STATUS_SUM,         // Status CSR: Supervisor access to user memory
36   input  logic                 STATUS_MPRV,        // Status CSR: modify machine privilege
37   input  logic [1:0]           STATUS_MPP,         // Status CSR: previous machine privilege level
38   input  logic                 ENVCFG_PBMTE,       // Page-based memory types enabled
39   input  logic                 ENVCFG_ADUE,        // HPTW A/D Update enable
40   input  logic [1:0]           PrivilegeModeW,     // Current privilege level of the processeor
41   input  logic                 DisableTranslation, // virtual address translation disabled during D$ flush and HPTW walk that use physical addresses
42   input  logic [P.XLEN+1:0]    VAdr,               // virtual/physical address from IEU or physical address from HPTW
43   input  logic [1:0]           Size,               // access size: 00 = 8 bits, 01 = 16 bits, 10 = 32 bits , 11 = 64 bits
44   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]    PTE,                // page table entry
45   input  logic [1:0]           PageTypeWriteVal,   // page type
46   input  logic                 TLBWrite,           // write TLB entry
47   input  logic                 TLBFlush,           // Invalidate all TLB entries
48   output logic [P.PA_BITS-1:0] PhysicalAddress,    // PAdr when no translation, or translated VAdr (TLBPAdr) when there is translation
49   output logic                 TLBMiss,            // Miss TLB
50   output logic                 Cacheable,          // PMA indicates memory address is cacheable
51   output logic                 Idempotent,         // PMA indicates memory address is idempotent
52   output logic                 SelTIM,             // Select a tightly integrated memory
53   // Faults
54   output logic                 InstrAccessFaultF, LoadAccessFaultM, StoreAmoAccessFaultM, // access fault sources
55   output logic                 InstrPageFaultF, LoadPageFaultM, StoreAmoPageFaultM,       // page fault sources
56   output logic                 UpdateDA,                                                  // page fault due to setting dirty or access bit
57   output logic                 LoadMisalignedFaultM, StoreAmoMisalignedFaultM,            // misaligned fault sources
58   // PMA checker signals
59   input  logic [3:0]           CMOpM,                                                     // Cache management instructions
60   input  logic                 AtomicAccessM, ExecuteAccessF, WriteAccessM, ReadAccessM,  // access type
61   input var logic [7:0]        PMPCFG_ARRAY_REGW[P.PMP_ENTRIES-1:0],                      // PMP configuration
62   input var logic [P.PA_BITS-3:0] PMPADDR_ARRAY_REGW[P.PMP_ENTRIES-1:0]                   // PMP addresses
63 );
64 
65   logic [P.PA_BITS-1:0]        TLBPAdr;                  // physical address for TLB                   
66   logic                        PMAInstrAccessFaultF;     // Instruction access fault from PMA
67   logic                        PMPInstrAccessFaultF;     // Instruction access fault from PMP
68   logic                        PMALoadAccessFaultM;      // Load access fault from PMA
69   logic                        PMPLoadAccessFaultM;      // Load access fault from PMP
70   logic                        PMAStoreAmoAccessFaultM;  // Store or AMO access fault from PMA
71   logic                        PMPStoreAmoAccessFaultM;  // Store or AMO access fault from PMP
72   logic                        DataMisalignedM;          // load or store misaligned
73   logic                        Translate;                // Translation occurs when virtual memory is active and DisableTranslation is off
74   logic                        TLBPageFault;             // Page fault from TLB
75   logic                        ReadNoAmoAccessM;         // Read that is not part of atomic operation causes Load faults.  Otherwise StoreAmo faults
76   logic [1:0]                  PBMemoryType;             // PBMT field of PTE during TLB hit, or 00 otherwise
77   logic                        AtomicMisalignedCausesAccessFaultM; // Misaligned atomics are not handled by hardware even with ZICCLSM, so it throws an access fault instead of misaligned with ZICCLSM
78   logic [1:0]                  EffectivePrivilegeModeW;  // Effective privilege mode accounting for MPRV
79 
80 
81   // Get Effective Privilege Mode
82   // for DLB, when mstatus.MPRV=1, use mstatus.MPP rather than the current privilege mode
83   assign EffectivePrivilegeModeW = IMMU ? PrivilegeModeW : (STATUS_MPRV ? STATUS_MPP : PrivilegeModeW);
84 
85   // only instantiate TLB if Virtual Memory is supported
86   if (P.VIRTMEM_SUPPORTED) begin:tlb
87     logic ReadAccess, WriteAccess;
88     assign ReadAccess = ExecuteAccessF | ReadAccessM; // execute also acts as a TLB read.  Execute and Read are never active for the same MMU, so safe to mix pipestages
89     assign WriteAccess = WriteAccessM;
90     tlb #(.P(P), .TLB_ENTRIES(TLB_ENTRIES), .ITLB(IMMU)) tlb(
91           .clk, .reset,
92           .SATP_MODE(SATP_REGW[P.XLEN-1:P.XLEN-P.SVMODE_BITS]),
93           .SATP_ASID(SATP_REGW[P.ASID_BASE+P.ASID_BITS-1:P.ASID_BASE]),
94           .VAdr(VAdr[P.XLEN-1:0]), .STATUS_MXR, .STATUS_SUM, .STATUS_MPRV, .STATUS_MPP, .ENVCFG_PBMTE, .ENVCFG_ADUE,
95           .EffectivePrivilegeModeW, .ReadAccess, .WriteAccess, .CMOpM,
96           .DisableTranslation, .PTE, .PageTypeWriteVal,
97           .TLBWrite, .TLBFlush, .TLBPAdr, .TLBMiss,
98           .Translate, .TLBPageFault, .UpdateDA, .PBMemoryType);
99   end else begin:tlb // just pass address through as physical
100     assign Translate    = 1'b0;
101     assign TLBMiss      = 1'b0;
102     assign TLBPageFault = 1'b0;
103     assign PBMemoryType = 2'b00;
104     assign UpdateDA     = 1'b0;
105     assign TLBPAdr      = '0;
106   end
107 
108   // If translation is occurring, select translated physical address from TLB
109   // the lower 12 bits are the page offset. These are never changed from the original
110   // non translated address.
111   mux2 #(P.PA_BITS-12) addressmux(VAdr[P.PA_BITS-1:12], TLBPAdr[P.PA_BITS-1:12], Translate, PhysicalAddress[P.PA_BITS-1:12]);
112   assign PhysicalAddress[11:0] = VAdr[11:0];
113   
114   ///////////////////////////////////////////
115   // Check physical memory accesses
116   ///////////////////////////////////////////
117 
118   pmachecker #(P) pmachecker(.PhysicalAddress, .Size, .CMOpM, 
119     .AtomicAccessM, .ExecuteAccessF, .WriteAccessM, .ReadAccessM, .PBMemoryType,
120     .Cacheable, .Idempotent, .SelTIM, 
121     .PMAInstrAccessFaultF, .PMALoadAccessFaultM, .PMAStoreAmoAccessFaultM);
122  
123   if (P.PMP_ENTRIES > 0) begin : pmp
124     pmpchecker #(P) pmpchecker(.PhysicalAddress, .EffectivePrivilegeModeW,
125       .PMPCFG_ARRAY_REGW, .PMPADDR_ARRAY_REGW,
126       .ExecuteAccessF, .WriteAccessM, .ReadAccessM, .Size, .CMOpM, 
127       .PMPInstrAccessFaultF, .PMPLoadAccessFaultM, .PMPStoreAmoAccessFaultM);
128   end else begin
129     assign PMPInstrAccessFaultF     = 1'b0;
130     assign PMPStoreAmoAccessFaultM  = 1'b0;
131     assign PMPLoadAccessFaultM      = 1'b0;
132   end
133 
134   assign ReadNoAmoAccessM  = ReadAccessM & ~WriteAccessM;// AMO causes StoreAmo rather than Load fault
135 
136   // Misaligned faults
137   always_comb // exclusion-tag: immu-wordaccess
138     case(Size)
139       2'b00:  DataMisalignedM = 1'b0;              // lb, sb, lbu
140       2'b01:  DataMisalignedM = VAdr[0];           // lh, sh, lhu
141       2'b10:  DataMisalignedM = VAdr[1] | VAdr[0]; // lw, sw, flw, fsw, lwu
142       2'b11:  DataMisalignedM = |VAdr[2:0];        // ld, sd, fld, fsd
143     endcase
144   // When ZiCCLSM_SUPPORTED, misalgined cacheable loads and stores are handled in hardware so they do not throw a misaligned fault
145   assign LoadMisalignedFaultM     = DataMisalignedM & ReadNoAmoAccessM & ~(P.ZICCLSM_SUPPORTED & Cacheable) & ~TLBMiss;
146   assign StoreAmoMisalignedFaultM = DataMisalignedM & WriteAccessM & ~(P.ZICCLSM_SUPPORTED & Cacheable) & ~TLBMiss; // Store and AMO both assert WriteAccess
147 
148   // a misaligned Atomic causes an access fault rather than a misaligned fault if a misaligned load/store is handled in hardware
149   // this is subtle - see privileged spec 3.6.3.3
150   assign AtomicMisalignedCausesAccessFaultM = DataMisalignedM & AtomicAccessM & (P.ZICCLSM_SUPPORTED & Cacheable);
151 
152   // Access faults
153   // If TLB miss and translating we want to not have faults from the PMA and PMP checkers.
154   assign InstrAccessFaultF    = (PMAInstrAccessFaultF    | PMPInstrAccessFaultF)    & ~TLBMiss;
155   assign LoadAccessFaultM     = (PMALoadAccessFaultM     | PMPLoadAccessFaultM     | AtomicMisalignedCausesAccessFaultM & ReadNoAmoAccessM)     & ~TLBMiss;
156   assign StoreAmoAccessFaultM = (PMAStoreAmoAccessFaultM | PMPStoreAmoAccessFaultM | AtomicMisalignedCausesAccessFaultM & WriteAccessM) & ~TLBMiss;
157 
158   // Specify which type of page fault is occurring
159   assign InstrPageFaultF    = TLBPageFault & ExecuteAccessF;
160   assign LoadPageFaultM     = TLBPageFault & ReadNoAmoAccessM; 
161   assign StoreAmoPageFaultM = TLBPageFault & (WriteAccessM | (|CMOpM));

31 module privileged import cvw::*;  #(parameter cvw_t P) (
32   input  logic              clk, reset,
33   input  logic              StallD, StallE, StallM, StallW,
34   input  logic              FlushD, FlushE, FlushM, FlushW,
35   // CSR Reads and Writes, and values needed for traps

40   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0] IEUAdrxTvalM,                                   // address from IEU
41   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0] PCM,                                            // program counter
42   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0] PCSpillM,                                       // program counter
43   // control signals

45   input  logic              CommittedM, CommittedF,                         // current instruction is using bus; don't interrupt
46   input  logic              PrivilegedM,                                    // privileged instruction
47   // processor events for performance counter logging
48   input  logic              FRegWriteM,                                     // instruction will write floating-point registers
49   input  logic              LoadStallD,                                     // load instruction is stalling
50   input  logic              StoreStallD,                                    // store instruction is stalling
51   input  logic              ICacheStallF,                                   // I cache stalled

54   input  logic              BTAWrongM,                                      // branch predictor guessed wrong target

56   input  logic              IClassWrongM,                                   // branch predictor guessed wrong instruction class

67   input  logic              LoadAccessFaultM, StoreAmoAccessFaultM,         // load or store access fault

69   input  logic              HPTWInstrPageFaultF,                            // hardware page table page fault while fetching instruction PTE
70   input  logic              InstrPageFaultF,                                // page faults
71   input  logic              LoadPageFaultM, StoreAmoPageFaultM,             // page faults

73   input  logic              LoadMisalignedFaultM, StoreAmoMisalignedFaultM, // misaligned data fault
74   input  logic              IllegalIEUFPUInstrD,                            // illegal instruction from IEU or FPU

86   output var logic [P.PA_BITS-3:0] PMPADDR_ARRAY_REGW [P.PMP_ENTRIES-1:0],  // PMP address entries to MMU
87   output logic [2:0]        FRM_REGW,                                       // FPU rounding mode
88   output logic [3:0]        ENVCFG_CBE,                                     // Cache block operation enables
89   output logic              ENVCFG_PBMTE,                                   // Page-based memory type enable
90   output logic              ENVCFG_ADUE,                                    // HPTW A/D Update enable
91   // PC logic output from privileged unit to IFU
92   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0] EPCM,                                           // Exception Program counter to IFU PC logic
93   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0] TrapVectorM,                                    // Trap vector, to IFU PC logic
94   // control outputs
95   output logic              RetM, TrapM,                                    // return instruction, or trap
96   output logic              sfencevmaM,                                     // sfence.vma instruction
97   input  logic              InvalidateICacheM,                              // fence instruction
98   output logic              BigEndianM,                                     // Use big endian in current privilege mode
99   // Fault outputs
100   output logic              wfiM, IntPendingM                               // Stall in Memory stage for WFI until interrupt pending or timeout
101 );
102 
103   logic [3:0]               CauseM;                                         // trap cause
104   logic [15:0]              MEDELEG_REGW;                                   // exception delegation CSR
105   logic [11:0]              MIDELEG_REGW;                                   // interrupt delegation CSR
106   logic                     sretM, mretM;                                   // supervisor / machine return instruction
107   logic                     IllegalCSRAccessM;                              // Illegal access to CSR
108   logic                     IllegalIEUFPUInstrM;                            // Illegal IEU or FPU instruction, delayed to Mem stage
109   logic                     InstrPageFaultM;                                // Instruction page fault, delayed to Mem stage
110   logic                     InstrAccessFaultM;                              // Instruction access fault, delayed to Mem stages
111   logic                     IllegalInstrFaultM;                             // Illegal instruction fault
112   logic                     STATUS_SPP, STATUS_TSR, STATUS_TW, STATUS_TVM;  // Status bits needed within privileged unit
113   logic                     STATUS_MIE, STATUS_SIE;                         // status bits: interrupt enables
114   logic [11:0]              MIP_REGW, MIE_REGW;                             // interrupt pending and enable bits
115   logic [1:0]               NextPrivilegeModeM;                             // next privilege mode based on trap or return
116   logic                     DelegateM;                                      // trap should be delegated
117   logic                     InterruptM;                                     // interrupt occurring
118   logic                     ExceptionM;                                     // Memory stage instruction caused a fault
119   logic                     HPTWInstrAccessFaultM;                          // Hardware page table access fault while fetching instruction PTE
120   logic                     HPTWInstrPageFaultM;                            // Hardware page table page fault while fetching instruction PTE
121   logic                     BreakpointFaultM, EcallFaultM;                  // breakpoint and Ecall traps should retire
122 
123   logic                     wfiW;
124 
125   // track the current privilege level
126   privmode #(P) privmode(.clk, .reset, .StallW, .TrapM, .mretM, .sretM, .DelegateM,
127     .STATUS_MPP, .STATUS_SPP, .NextPrivilegeModeM, .PrivilegeModeW);
128 
129   // decode privileged instructions
130   privdec #(P) pmd(.clk, .reset, .StallW, .FlushW, .InstrM(InstrM[31:7]),
131     .PrivilegedM, .IllegalIEUFPUInstrM, .IllegalCSRAccessM,
132     .PrivilegeModeW, .STATUS_TSR, .STATUS_TVM, .STATUS_TW, .IllegalInstrFaultM,
133     .EcallFaultM, .BreakpointFaultM, .sretM, .mretM, .RetM, .wfiM, .wfiW, .sfencevmaM);
134 
135   // Control and Status Registers
136   csr #(P) csr(.clk, .reset, .FlushM, .FlushW, .StallE, .StallM, .StallW,
137     .InstrM, .InstrOrigM, .PCM, .PCSpillM, .SrcAM, .IEUAdrxTvalM,
138     .CSRReadM, .CSRWriteM, .TrapM, .mretM, .sretM, .InterruptM,
139     .MTimerInt, .MExtInt, .SExtInt, .MSwInt,
140     .MTIME_CLINT, .InstrValidM, .FRegWriteM, .LoadStallD, .StoreStallD,
141     .BPDirWrongM, .BTAWrongM, .RASPredPCWrongM, .BPWrongM,
142     .sfencevmaM, .ExceptionM, .InvalidateICacheM, .ICacheStallF, .DCacheStallM, .DivBusyE, .FDivBusyE,
143     .IClassWrongM, .IClassM, .DCacheMiss, .DCacheAccess, .ICacheMiss, .ICacheAccess,
144     .NextPrivilegeModeM, .PrivilegeModeW, .CauseM, .SelHPTW,
145     .STATUS_MPP, .STATUS_SPP, .STATUS_TSR, .STATUS_TVM,
146     .STATUS_MIE, .STATUS_SIE, .STATUS_MXR, .STATUS_SUM, .STATUS_MPRV, .STATUS_TW, .STATUS_FS,
147     .MEDELEG_REGW, .MIP_REGW, .MIE_REGW, .MIDELEG_REGW,
148     .SATP_REGW, .PMPCFG_ARRAY_REGW, .PMPADDR_ARRAY_REGW,
149     .SetFflagsM, .FRM_REGW, .ENVCFG_CBE, .ENVCFG_PBMTE, .ENVCFG_ADUE,
150     .EPCM, .TrapVectorM,
151     .CSRReadValW, .IllegalCSRAccessM, .BigEndianM);
152 
153   // pipeline early-arriving trap sources
154   privpiperegs ppr(.clk, .reset, .StallD, .StallE, .StallM, .FlushD, .FlushE, .FlushM,
155     .InstrPageFaultF, .InstrAccessFaultF, .HPTWInstrAccessFaultF, .HPTWInstrPageFaultF, .IllegalIEUFPUInstrD,
156     .InstrPageFaultM, .InstrAccessFaultM, .HPTWInstrAccessFaultM, .HPTWInstrPageFaultM, .IllegalIEUFPUInstrM);
157 
158   // trap logic
159   trap #(P) trap(.reset,
160     .InstrMisalignedFaultM, .InstrAccessFaultM, .HPTWInstrAccessFaultM, .HPTWInstrPageFaultM, .IllegalInstrFaultM,
161     .BreakpointFaultM, .LoadMisalignedFaultM, .StoreAmoMisalignedFaultM,
162     .LoadAccessFaultM, .StoreAmoAccessFaultM, .EcallFaultM, .InstrPageFaultM,
163     .LoadPageFaultM, .StoreAmoPageFaultM, .PrivilegeModeW,
164     .MIP_REGW, .MIE_REGW, .MIDELEG_REGW, .MEDELEG_REGW, .STATUS_MIE, .STATUS_SIE,
165     .InstrValidM, .CommittedM, .CommittedF,
166     .TrapM, .wfiM, .wfiW, .InterruptM, .ExceptionM, .IntPendingM, .DelegateM, .CauseM);

32 module csr import cvw::*;  #(parameter cvw_t P) (
33   input  logic                     clk, reset,
34   input  logic                     FlushM, FlushW,
35   input  logic                     StallE, StallM, StallW,
36   input  logic [31:0]              InstrM,                    // current instruction
37   input  logic [31:0]              InstrOrigM,                // Original compressed or uncompressed instruction in Memory stage for Illegal Instruction MTVAL
38   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]        PCM,                       // program counter, next PC going to trap/return logic
39   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]        PCSpillM,                  // program counter, next PC going to trap/return logic aligned after an instruction spill
40   input  logic [P.XLEN-1:0]        SrcAM, IEUAdrxTvalM,       // SrcA and memory address from IEU
41   input  logic                     CSRReadM, CSRWriteM,       // read or write CSR
42   input  logic                     TrapM,                     // trap is occurring
43   input  logic                     mretM, sretM,              // return instruction
44   input  logic                     InterruptM,                // interrupt is occurring
45   input  logic                     ExceptionM,                // interrupt is occurring
46   input  logic                     MTimerInt,                 // timer interrupt
47   input  logic                     MExtInt, SExtInt,          // external interrupt (from PLIC)
48   input  logic                     MSwInt,                    // software interrupt
49   input  logic [63:0]              MTIME_CLINT,               // TIME value from CLINT
50   input  logic                     InstrValidM,               // current instruction is valid
51   input  logic                     FRegWriteM,                // writes to floating point registers change STATUS.FS
52   input  logic [4:0]               SetFflagsM,                // Set floating point flag bits in FCSR
53   input  logic [1:0]               NextPrivilegeModeM,        // STATUS bits updated based on next privilege mode
54   input  logic [1:0]               PrivilegeModeW,            // current privilege mode
55   input  logic [3:0]               CauseM,                    // Trap cause
56   input  logic                     SelHPTW,                   // hardware page table walker active, so base endianness on supervisor mode
57   // inputs for performance counters
58   input  logic                     LoadStallD, StoreStallD,
59   input  logic                     ICacheStallF,
60   input  logic                     DCacheStallM,
61   input  logic                     BPDirWrongM,
62   input  logic                     BTAWrongM,
63   input  logic                     RASPredPCWrongM,
64   input  logic                     IClassWrongM,
65   input  logic                     BPWrongM,                  // branch predictor is wrong
66   input  logic [3:0]               IClassM,
67   input  logic                     DCacheMiss,
68   input  logic                     DCacheAccess,
69   input  logic                     ICacheMiss,
70   input  logic                     ICacheAccess,
71   input  logic                     sfencevmaM,
72   input  logic                     InvalidateICacheM,
73   input  logic                     DivBusyE,                  // integer divide busy
74   input  logic                     FDivBusyE,                 // floating point divide busy
75   // outputs from CSRs
76   output logic [1:0]               STATUS_MPP,
77   output logic                     STATUS_SPP, STATUS_TSR, STATUS_TVM,
78   output logic [15:0]              MEDELEG_REGW,
79   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]        SATP_REGW,
80   output logic [11:0]              MIP_REGW, MIE_REGW, MIDELEG_REGW,
81   output logic                     STATUS_MIE, STATUS_SIE,
82   output logic                     STATUS_MXR, STATUS_SUM, STATUS_MPRV, STATUS_TW,
83   output logic [1:0]               STATUS_FS,
84   output var logic [7:0]           PMPCFG_ARRAY_REGW[P.PMP_ENTRIES-1:0],
85   output var logic [P.PA_BITS-3:0] PMPADDR_ARRAY_REGW[P.PMP_ENTRIES-1:0],
86   output logic [2:0]               FRM_REGW,
87   output logic [3:0]               ENVCFG_CBE,
88   output logic                     ENVCFG_PBMTE,              // Page-based memory type enable
89   output logic                     ENVCFG_ADUE,               // HPTW A/D Update enable
90   // PC logic output from privileged unit to IFU
91   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]        EPCM,                      // Exception Program counter to IFU PC logic
92   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]        TrapVectorM,               // Trap vector, to IFU PC logic
93   //
94   output logic [P.XLEN-1:0]        CSRReadValW,               // value read from CSR
95   output logic                     IllegalCSRAccessM,         // Illegal CSR access: CSR doesn't exist or is inaccessible at this privilege level
96   output logic                     BigEndianM                 // memory access is big-endian based on privilege mode and STATUS register endian fields
97 );
98 
99   localparam MIP = 12'h344;
100   localparam SIP = 12'h144;
101 
102   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       CSRMReadValM, CSRSReadValM, CSRUReadValM, CSRCReadValM;
103   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       CSRReadValM;
104   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       CSRSrcM;
105   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       CSRRWM, CSRRSM, CSRRCM;
106   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       CSRWriteValM;
107   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       MSTATUS_REGW, SSTATUS_REGW, MSTATUSH_REGW;
108   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       STVEC_REGW, MTVEC_REGW;
109   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       MEPC_REGW, SEPC_REGW;
110   logic [31:0]             MCOUNTINHIBIT_REGW, MCOUNTEREN_REGW, SCOUNTEREN_REGW;
111   logic                    WriteMSTATUSM, WriteMSTATUSHM, WriteSSTATUSM;
112   logic                    CSRMWriteM, CSRSWriteM, CSRUWriteM;
113   logic                    UngatedCSRMWriteM;
114   logic                    WriteFRMM, SetOrWriteFFLAGSM;
115   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       UnalignedNextEPCM, NextEPCM, NextMtvalM;
116   logic [4:0]              NextCauseM;
117   logic [11:0]             CSRAdrM;
118   logic                    IllegalCSRCAccessM, IllegalCSRMAccessM, IllegalCSRSAccessM, IllegalCSRUAccessM;
119   logic                    InsufficientCSRPrivilegeM;
120   logic                    IllegalCSRMWriteReadonlyM;
121   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       CSRReadVal2M;
122   logic [11:0]             MIP_REGW_writeable;
123   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       TVecM,NextFaultMtvalM;
124   logic                    MTrapM, STrapM;
125   logic                    SelMtvecM;
126   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       TVecAlignedM;
127   logic                    InstrValidNotFlushedM;
128   logic                    STimerInt;
129   logic [63:0]             MENVCFG_REGW;
130   logic [P.XLEN-1:0]       SENVCFG_REGW;
131   logic                    ENVCFG_STCE; // supervisor timer counter enable
132   logic                    ENVCFG_FIOM; // fence implies io (presently not used)
133 
134   // only valid unflushed instructions can access CSRs
135   assign InstrValidNotFlushedM = InstrValidM & ~StallW & ~FlushW;
136 
137   ///////////////////////////////////////////
138   // MTVAL: gets value from PC, Instruction, or load/store address
139   ///////////////////////////////////////////
140 
141   always_comb
142     if (InterruptM)           NextFaultMtvalM = '0;
143     else case (CauseM)
144       12, 1, 3:               NextFaultMtvalM = PCSpillM;  // Instruction page/access faults, breakpoint
145       2:                      NextFaultMtvalM = {{(P.XLEN-32){1'b0}}, InstrOrigM}; // Illegal instruction fault
146       0, 4, 6, 13, 15, 5, 7:  NextFaultMtvalM = IEUAdrxTvalM; // Instruction misaligned, Load/Store Misaligned/page/access faults
147       default:                NextFaultMtvalM = '0; // Ecall, interrupts
148     endcase
149 
150   ///////////////////////////////////////////
151   // Trap Vectoring & Returns; vectored traps must be aligned to 64-byte address boundaries
152   ///////////////////////////////////////////
153 
154   // Select trap vector from STVEC or MTVEC and word-align
155   assign SelMtvecM = (NextPrivilegeModeM == P.M_MODE);
156   mux2 #(P.XLEN) tvecmux(STVEC_REGW, MTVEC_REGW, SelMtvecM, TVecM);
157   assign TVecAlignedM = {TVecM[P.XLEN-1:2], 2'b00};
158 
159   // Support vectored interrupts
160   if(P.VECTORED_INTERRUPTS_SUPPORTED) begin:vec
161     logic VectoredM;
162     logic [P.XLEN-1:0] TVecPlusCauseM;
163     assign VectoredM = InterruptM & (TVecM[1:0] == 2'b01);
164     assign TVecPlusCauseM = {TVecAlignedM[P.XLEN-1:6], CauseM, 2'b00}; // 64-byte alignment allows concatenation rather than addition
165     mux2 #(P.XLEN) trapvecmux(TVecAlignedM, TVecPlusCauseM, VectoredM, TrapVectorM);
166   end else
167     assign TrapVectorM = TVecAlignedM; // unvectored interrupt handler can be at any word-aligned address. This is called Sstvecd
168

192       2'b10:   CSRWriteValM = CSRRSM;
193       2'b11:   CSRWriteValM = CSRRCM;
